jobs.occupation: Technical Service Engineer – European Region (full-time, m/f/d) (Außendienstmitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Absen Optoelectronic Co., Ltd., founded in 2001, is a global leader in LED display manufacturing, renowned for its innovation, reliability, and customer-centric approach. With over 3,000 employees worldwide, we provide cutting-edge LED display solutions across diverse industries.

Absen GmbH, founded in 2013, is the German subsidiary of the Absen Group, headquartered in Mörfelden-Walldorf near Frankfurt am Main. It directly manages the European market, coordinating all sales, service, and logistics activities across Europe, working closely with customers and partners, and ensuring that Absen’s high-quality standards are consistently met.

Technical Service Engineer – European Region 

(full-time, m/f/d)

Location: Mörfelden-Walldorf, Germany (near Frankfurt am Main)

Reporting to: European Service Manager

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technical Service Engineer to join our local service team in Germany and work closely with the European service organization.

Reporting to the European Service Manager, you will receive comprehensive onboarding training and ongoing business guidance to help you quickly gain an understanding of our products, customer service processes, and internal systems, enabling you to successfully integrate into the team and take ownership of your responsibilities.

Responsibilities

- Provide technical consultation, troubleshooting and solution support to customers and partners via phone, email, instant messaging and remote diagnostic tools.
- Diagnose and resolve LED display hardware and software issues remotely and on-site. Prepare detailed fault analysis and service reports.
- Act as the technical point of contact for end customers, system integrators and channel partners across Europe, handling technical inquiries, service requests and escalations.
- Travel across Europe to customer sites as required to provide installation guidance, commissioning, maintenance and repair support, ensuring successful project acceptance and delivery.
- Provide technical training to customers and partners on product operation, routine maintenance, system commissioning, troubleshooting and LED module repair.
- Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues and contribute to continuous improvements in service quality and customer satisfaction.

Qualification

- Technical education or vocational training in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field; a bachelor’s degree or above is a plus.
- Relevant professional experience in technical service, field service, or a related technical role. Experience in the LED display or AV industry is a strong advantage.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
- Fluent English required; German proficiency is a plus, with Chinese proficiency also considered an advantage.
- Strong customer-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- Willingness to travel extensively across Europe, approximately 50%–70%, and ability to work independently on customer-facing on-site assignments.
- Detail-oriented, well-organized, and capable of working with a structured and systematic approach.

What We Offer

- A supportive, collaborative, and international working environment.
- A flat organizational structure with efficient and open communication.
- A competitive compensation package.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities.
- 30 days of paid annual leave per year.
- Flexible working hours.
- Travel allowances and comprehensive support for business trips.
- Birthday and Christmas benefits.
- Free coffee and beverages in the office.
- Free parking.

Become part of the Absen family!

We look forward to welcoming you to the Absen family!

Please send your complete application to: wlong@absen-europe.com (https://mailto:wlong@absen-europe.com) .

jobs.occupation: Research Scientist and Curator (m/f/d) of the section Vertebrata (Tenure Track) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Museum of Natural History in Görlitz, ideally as of April 1, 2027:

Research Scientist and Curator (m/f/d) of the section Vertebrata (Tenure Track)

(full time / part time options available)

Location: Görlitz

Employment scope: full time / part time options are available

Type of contract: initially limited to three years; 

the type of time limitation depends on individual profile and legal framework (maximum 3+3 years). A permanent employment is planned after a positive evaluation

Remuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The renowned Senckenberg Museum of Natural History, located in the medieval town of Görlitz, combines research at an international level with extensive collections and an engaging museum program. The surrounding Upper Lusatia region offers a large variety of opportunities for experiencing nature.

Senckenberg is committed to study the causes and effects of biodiversity loss in the Anthropocene. As part of our strategic development, we launched an ambitious long-term research effort in “Anthropocene Biodiversity Loss” encompassing the modules “Collectomics”, “Biodiversity Genomics”, and “Solution Labs”. Objectives include the transformation of natural history collections into the digital era, studying biodiversity from the genome to the ecosystem levels and offering exploratory spaces for science and society to develop common solutions to Anthropocene challenges.

For the Görlitz vertebrate collection, which comprises approximately 70,000 specimens (preserved using dry, cryogenic, and liquid preservation methods, with the focus on mammals; birds make up a smaller proportion, while other vertebrate groups represent only a small fraction), we are seeking an internationally recognized scientist with a solid track record in mammal research, possibly supplemented by work on another vertebrate groups.

Potential research topics may include various aspects such as mammalian diversity, functional morphology, phylogeny, or biological interactions. Curation and collection-based research should play a significant role in the applicant’s research approach. The selected candidate should be open to research collaborations with SGN colleagues

Your tasks

- Scientific curation and development of the vertebrate collection and the associated resources as an important international research infrastructure through international networking, growth, and improved accessibility.
- Develop a visible portfolio of collection-based research with basic and applied aspects in the broad field of mammalogy and possibly other vertebrate groups by using a range of established and innovative methods and approaches.
- Taking responsibility for the relocation of the collection items, including the infrastructure of the Mammalogy/Vertebrate Section, to the new campus at Bahnhofstraße 30 at Görlitz.
- Secure external research funds.
- Publish results of your research in international scientific outlets.
- Establish collaborations with ongoing projects, regional and national region (e.g., long-term projects on wolf, lynx) and international (e.g., Africa, Mongolia), including with other sections and departments in Görlitz and further Senckenberg institutes.
- Communicate with external stakeholders such as scientific associations, conservation agencies, local and regional authorities, as well as citizen scientists.
- Participate in teaching in the MSc level programs of International Institute Zittau/ Dresden University of Technology.

Your profile 

- Doctoral degree in biology/zoology or a related field
- Expert knowledge of mammals, including native species (the biogeographic focus of the mammal collection is currently the Palearctic), additional expertise in other vertebrate groups
- Proactive willingness to implement innovative research approaches, such as in the field of genomics, morphometrics, AI, imaging, 3D methods, pollutant analysis in a collection context
- Ability to identify attractive research questions and make use of synergies through collaborations
- Excellent academic track record adequate to your career stage
- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding and project management
- Experience in supervising staff (doctoral candidates, BSc., MSc., students, technical staff), ability to work in a team
- Very good command of German (B2)
- Fluency in English, both spoken and written
- Class B driving licence (international driving licence)
- Willingness to travel on occasion to the extent possible considering your personal circumstances

Desirable skills 

- Knowledge in molecular, biochemical or biophysical techniques in taxonomy and ecology
- Knowledge in research data management and databases
- Experience in curation and management of zoological collections, and in museum work

We offer 

- Access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- An attractive job within the inspiring and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution with excellent infrastructures and collaborations opportunities, e. g. in morphology, genomics, evolutionary biology, (paleo-)ecology
- A working place in completely new building with dissection and other laboratories, collection rooms, in the historic town of Görlitz with rapidly developing local research community (DZA, CASUS, IHI/TUD, HiLusatia), yet situated very close to nature with high mammal diversity and opportunities for field work
- Opportunities to participate in teaching and outreach activities, e.g., in our museum and with collaborating universities
- Opportunities for establishing an independent academic working group and acquiring further academic qualifications
- Flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card  with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement  – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability, they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply? 

Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) as a single PDF file by November 10, 2026

https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/.

For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/ (https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/)

For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de (http://www.senckenberg.de)

Contact 

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung

Senckenberganlage 25

60325 Frankfurt a.M.

jobs.occupation: 23 Interdisciplinary PhD positions in Ultrafast Science and Quantum Materials – IMPRS UFAST (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
The International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging and Structural Dynamics in Hamburg, Germany, offers a structured PhD program focusing on ultra-fast phenomena, X-ray physics and dynamical imaging in all areas of science covering physics, chemistry and biology.

23 Interdisciplinary PhD positions in Ultrafast Science and Quantum Materials – IMPRS UFAST – Hamburg

Research

The program offers exciting research opportunities at ultra-intense electron and X-ray sources to directly observe atomic motions during primary events. The use of ultrafast imaging over the relevant length and time scales generates new levels of understanding of the interplay between structure and dynamics. Specific areas include the theoretical and experimental aspects of quantum materials and atomically resolved dynamics, fundamental light-matter interaction, accelerator-based light sources, coherent controlled molecular and solid state dynamics, molecular imaging, extreme timescale spectroscopy, ultrafast optics and X-ray science

We offer:

- A range of PhD positions in these areas: open positions (https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/350422/open_phd_projects)
- State-of-the-art research facilities on an extensive science campus
- Cross-disciplinary research in a vibrant, international scientific environment
- First class supervision and mentorship by a team of internationally renowned experts
- Outstanding training in your scientific subject and transferable skills (in English)
- A 3-year employment contract based on the German federal pay agreement

Requirements

We seek applicants with an excellent academic background. You hold (or are about to complete) an MSc degree or equivalent in physics, chemistry or related areas. You need to be passionate about research in ultrafast phenomena and motivated to conduct rigorous scientific work over the full degree period.

Apply

Applications must be submitted via the [online application portal

](https://jobs.b-ite.com/en/jobposting/760bb8588f9051b5f5b84840eb91eff55142a8780/apply)The application deadline is 06th November 2026. PhD projects start in summer/autumn 2026. In exceptional cases, it may possible to start on the research project earlier. For any further questions or problems regarding the application process or the online system, please contact the IMPRS UFAST coordinator on IMPRS.UFAST@mpsd.mpg.de.

jobs.description:

By translating customer and business needs into robust system solutions and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, you will help deliver innovative, reliable imaging technologies that drive Philips' success and create value for customers.

Your role: 

- Define, introduce, and maintain system architectures for x-ray tubes, generators, and X-segments, including interfaces, system requirements, and modular building blocks. 
- Translate stakeholder, user, and business needs into clear, measurable, and traceable product requirements and design decisions. 
- Drive technology choices, design trade-off analyses, and the selection of suitable methods and tools to deliver balanced, robust solutions. 
- Lead system integration and verification, including the management of requirements, interfaces, and deviations through to system readiness.

How We Work Together 

We believe that we achieve better results when we work together rather than apart. For this role this means to be on-site at least 3 days a week. 

About Philips 

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:

PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation

You are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.

In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.

Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.

Your Profile

- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning
- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning
- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs
- natural language generation and explainability
- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling
- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.
- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.
- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.
- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.
- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

- Monthly stipend of €1,650
- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

- Expected start date: February, 2026

Application package must include:

- Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Academic transcripts
- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals
- 2 recommendation letters

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and multidisciplinary cooperation. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1.800 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:

Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)
(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)

Your Responsibilities:

The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. The implementation of AI, machine learning, or data-driven control / optimization is highly welcome, for example, for synthesis planning, activity prediction, sensing, or structural topology. The successful candidate is expected to engage in innovative research in organic chemistry and to maintain a cutting-edge, externally funded research program that energizes the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in the field of organic chemistry, including fundamental and advanced lectures and laboratories at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. The expertise in teaching organic chemistry forms an integral part of the basic education in the BSc programs “Chemistry and Biotechnology” and “Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology”. Moreover, the candidate is expected to take a pivotal role in the MSc programs “Quantitative Life Science” and/or “Advanced Materials” with complementary research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master, and PhD theses as well as research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. jobs.occupation: Account Manager Powerwall, Frankfurt am Main, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales in Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products, with a primary focus on Powerwall 3P — Tesla’s three-phase home battery and integrated inverter, purpose-built for the German and European grid. Following the launch of Powerwall 3P in Germany, you will scale adoption through distributors and third-party installers, grow a high-performing partner network, and drive business development in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with a background in PV or energy storage. Beyond strong execution and a team-oriented mindset, successful candidates bring creativity, passion, and the drive to lead in a fast-moving technology and market landscape. * This position can be based anywhere in Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall 3P and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany
- Build and grow relationships across partner organizations (distributors, installers, and related channels), clearly communicating Tesla’s product portfolio, three-phase value proposition, and feature roadmap
- Drive partner readiness and ramp for Powerwall 3P: onboarding, enablement, pipeline building, and conversion from interest to installed systems
- Evaluate new business opportunities with existing and new accounts and/or sales channels, match suitable product offerings (including Powerwall 3P for three-phase residential and small commercial sites), and own capture of those opportunities
- Deliver market insights to the broader business — including competitive dynamics, installer feedback, and adoption barriers/opportunities specific to three-phase storage in Germany
- Provide accurate sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams, reflecting Powerwall 3P ramp and channel mix
- Support assessment of market dynamics across sectors (utility, C&I, residential) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, grid requirements, incentive programs)
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall and Powerwall 3P
- Identify and support initiatives that improve partner training, installation quality, fulfilment, and Tesla support — with particular focus on three-phase design, commissioning, and backup use cases
- Provide user and customer feedback to IT on Tesla tools/systems and to Operations on processes

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years in account management or channel sales within the PV or energy storage industry
- Strong understanding of residential/small commercial energy storage, ideally including three-phase (3P) systems, hybrid inverters, and grid-tied architectures common in Germany
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, grid connection practices, and relevant German/EU regulatory and incentive frameworks
- Excellent communication and documentation skills
- Ability to prioritize and run multiple projects and partner workstreams in parallel
- Fluency in English and German
- Flexibility to travel within Germany (and occasionally the broader region)

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.
